svg.title: V-24. HSI internal block diagram (SysML v2 view hsiInternalBlocks)
svg.desc: SysML internal block diagram generated from the model for the hardware-software interface of WP-S-05. Above the boundary, the safety MCU firmware E-03b and the other software owners of each interface (E-03a, host pandad); on the boundary, the 14 interfaces HSI-01 to HSI-14 with their status, signals, TSRs and who detects a failure; below, the parts of the safety MCU hardware E-04a each interface uses, and the parts outside the MCU they lead to.
svg.text: The 14 hardware-software interfaces of the safety MCU: the firmware and SoC software that own them above, the parts of the MCU hardware they use below
E-03b Platform firmware : PlatformFirmware · ASIL C · drivers, comms, fault handling, bootstub
«part» E-04a STM32H7 safety MCU : SafetyMcuHardware · ASIL C

14 interfaces cross the boundary between the firmware and the MCU hardware: 1 in place, 12 partial, 1 missing (WP-S-05 §11.4). At 3 (HSI-05, HSI-07, HSI-11) a failure of the other side is not detected today. Each line is a connection of the model: an interface to the
software that owns it (WP-S-05 §11.4) and to the hardware parts its resource names (§2, check H5).
port of E-04a to a part outside the MCU
part colours: integrity, as in V-03
